stories.title: North Wales police commissioner seeks views on council tax rise
stories.summary: Andy Dunbobbin has launched a consultation on four options, ranging from 34p to 45p a week per Band D household, to raise North Wales Police's funding.

stories.title: Police warn people across North Wales over missed delivery scam texts
stories.summary: North Wales Police has warned people across the region about fake text messages claiming a parcel delivery has been missed. stories.title: North Wales pays Britain’s highest electricity charges as Flintshire MS calls for cheaper power, not net zero at any price
stories.summary: North Wales pays Britain’s highest electricity charges as Flintshire MS calls for “cheaper power, not net zero at any price”

stories.title: Sixteen Flintshire roads closed today, with Mold worst hit
stories.summary: Drivers in Mold face 10 sets of roadworks today, with Llys Nercwys closed until Wednesday 2 December.

stories.title: Black Friday warning as fake phone network scams hit 15,000 cases
stories.summary: Scams by fraudsters pretending to be mobile phone networks are up 85% this year. There have been more than 15,000 cases so far, which is 58 a day, according to fraud prevention service Cifas. Losses have passed an estimated £32 million. The scammers offer cheap handsets, free upgrades or time-limited Black Friday and Christmas deals
